Name: Aikatsu hairstyle and clothes pack
Author: CrazyHamaster
Description:
[b]"Aikatsu hairstyle and clothes pack"[/b] is a fashion sense mod inspired by the world of [i]Aikatsu![/i] — an anime series filled with charm, friendship, and the sparkling dreams of becoming an idol. It was the first anime series I watched in my childhood!


[b]Features (Current Version)[/b][list]
[*][b] School Uniform Look[/b]
Including the classic uniform (Blue) and summer uniform.[*][b]Hairstyle and "Hats"[/b]
[/list] ﻿Hoshimiya Ichigo, Kiriya Aoi, Shibuki Ran.
[b]
Requirements[/b]
This mod requires [b]Fashion Sense[/b].
Please make sure you have it installed and working before using this mod.
[b]Recommended Setup:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version)
[*]Fashion Sense
[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu – for easier toggling in game
[/list][b]
Installation
[/b]Unzip this mod into your Mods folder.[list=1]

[/list][b]Plans for Future Updates[/b]
More outfits and hairstyles from the [i]Aikatsu![/i] universe will be added soon, including:
[list]
[*]Other idols' hairstyles
[*]Stage outfits
[/list]
💌 This is a small fan mod created with love for [i]Aikatsu![/i] and cozy farm life.
If you enjoy this mod or have suggestions, feel free to reach out or leave a comment! I'm still learning and updating as I go, so thank you for your support and patience 🌷

- Add Aoi and Ran's hairstyle
- Add summer uniform
